novel_features.name: Conversation Analytics
novel_features.description: See message counts, response patterns, and activity trends across all your Zylos conversations.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local SQLite aggregation across all synced messages — no single API call provides this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to understand your interaction patterns and Zylos usage trends without manual counting.

novel_features.name: Message Timeline
novel_features.description: View your conversation history as a chronological timeline with gap detection.
novel_features.rationale: Requires temporal ordering and gap detection across synced conversation history in SQLite.
novel_features.why_it_matters: See the full arc of a conversation day at a glance, including gaps where the AI was idle.

novel_features.name: Context-Aware Search
novel_features.description: Search conversation history with surrounding messages for context.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 returns surrounding messages for matched results — needs local store to join.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find what was discussed around a keyword, not just the matching message alone.

novel_features.name: Response Time Tracking
novel_features.description: Analyze AI response times across conversations.
novel_features.rationale: Timestamps on in/out messages enable per-conversation response time analysis in SQLite.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Track whether the AI agent is getting slower or faster over time.

novel_features.name: Conversation Export
novel_features.description: Export conversations to JSON or Markdown for archival and sharing.
novel_features.rationale: Round-trip archive format using local SQLite store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Archive important conversations before clearing history or migrating setups.

novel_features.name: Status Watch Mode
novel_features.description: Monitor AI agent status with state-change detection and auto-exit.
novel_features.rationale: Periodic polling with state-change detection requires coordinated HTTP + timing logic.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Wait for the AI to become available before sending a message, scriptable in CI.

novel_features.name: Message Streaming
novel_features.description: Stream new messages in real-time, pipeable to other tools.
novel_features.rationale: Long-poll streaming with structured output requires coordinated HTTP polling + output formatting.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tail the AI conversation in real-time from scripts or other CLIs.

narrative.headline: Every Zylos conversation, from the terminal — with offline search, analytics, and streaming no other tool offers.
narrative.value_prop: Zylos Console CLI connects to your local Zylos instance to send messages, monitor status, and sync conversations to a local SQLite database. Search past messages offline, analyze response patterns, and stream new messages in real-time.

quickstart.comment: Authenticate with your Zylos instance (password or ZYLOS_PASSWORD env var)
Check if the AI agent is ready
Sync all conversations to local SQLite for offline search

troubleshoots.fix: Run zylos-pp-cli session login or set ZYLOS_PASSWORD env var
Ensure Zylos is running: check Docker container or process
Verify auth session is valid with zylos-pp-cli doctor

narrative.when_to_use: Use the Zylos CLI when you need to interact with a local Zylos Console instance from scripts, automation pipelines, or a terminal. Ideal for monitoring AI agent status, archiving conversations, or piping messages between tools.

recipes.explanation: Blocks until the AI agent is idle — useful in automation scripts.

recipes.title: Search conversations and extract content
recipes.explanation: Search for messages mentioning 'error' with surrounding context, extract just the content field.

recipes.title: Stream new messages to a file
recipes.explanation: Append new messages as JSON lines to a log file for persistent monitoring.

recipes.explanation: Create a Markdown file with your full conversation for documentation.
